'''Tara''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Tara worked as a waitress in the bar [[Spanner's]], which was located in the city of [[Hedrett]], on Cularin. She had worked there for two years when the [[heroes of Cularin]] visited the bar in about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].

==Personality and traits==
Tara was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] with long, brown hair that was braided. She liked the clientele and atmosphere of Spanner's, and was good at her job.
